description: Free. Scan a stored Living QR. GET https://authichain.com/qron/r/{object_id} returns AuthiChain Verification Decision v1. This host verifies the signature. A missing id is presentation_not_found. Not an x402 payment endpoint, and it does not inspect a physical product.

object_id.description: Stored presentation id. Canonical form is qron:url: plus 8 hex characters.

name: scan_living_qr
